texts.preamble: Nadirbhai Hakimbhai Shekh vs The Chief Officer, Sahera Nagar Palika on 23 January, 2024 Author: Vaibhavi D. Nanavati Bench: Vaibhavi D. Nanavati Neutral Ci C/Sca/20945/2023 Order
texts.facts: 3. It is the case of the writ-applicant that by way of present writ-application the writ-applicant herein seeks direction to provide legal and valid NOC and permission for running slaughter house under the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 for licensing and registration of food business.
texts.arguments: 5. Mr. Bloch, the learned advocate appearing for the writ- applicant on instructions states that the writ-applicant would prefer an application in the prescribed format with the respondent authority and that the same be decided by the respondent authority in terms of the order passed by the Hon'ble Division Bench in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021 dated 11.4.2023 in paragraphs 6.3 and 6.4. 6. Mr. Patel, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent authority submitted that the respondent authority would consider if such an application is filed in line with the order dated 11.4.2023 passed in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021. NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20945/2023 ORDER DATED: 23/01/2024 undefined 7. Considering the aforesaid and statement made by Mr. Bloch, the learned advocate appearing for the writ-applicant, if the writ-applicant were to approach the respondent authority by preferring an application in the prescribed format seeking permission to run a slaughter house, the same be considered by the respondent authority in accordance with law and in line with the ratio laid down in order dated 11.4.2023 passed in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021. 8.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 5. Mr. Bloch, the learned advocate appearing for the writ- applicant on instructions states that the writ-applicant would prefer an application in the prescribed format with the respondent authority and that the same be decided by the respondent authority in terms of the order passed by the Hon'ble Division Bench in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021 dated 11.4.2023 in paragraphs 6.3 and 6.4. 6. Mr. Patel, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent authority submitted that the respondent authority would consider if such an application is filed in line with the order dated 11.4.2023 passed in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021. NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20945/2023 ORDER DATED: 23/01/2024 undefined 7. Considering the aforesaid and statement made by Mr. Bloch, the learned advocate appearing for the writ-applicant, if the writ-applicant were to approach the respondent authority by preferring an application in the prescribed format seeking permission to run a slaughter house, the same be considered by the respondent authority in accordance with law and in line with the ratio laid down in order dated 11.4.2023 passed in the Civil Application No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021. 8.
